decisions.reason: The existing message-238 MODIFY already records the repaired-leak precondition and all required demonstration elements, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The existing message-238 MODIFY already records the requirement for both stations to operate simultaneously.
Requiring leak-free continuous plumbing operation does not change the dispensing path's cleaning, sanitation-access, removal, or liquid-trap requirements.

The leak-free acceptance condition does not change the valve mechanism, operator controls, dispensing sequence, or controlled-flow behavior; dispensing from both spouts is already covered by the demonstration requirement and existing scope.
The plumbing leak repair and acceptance condition do not change spout geometry, orientation, material, appearance, or pour direction.
The source decision does not alter cup clearance, platform dimensions, footprint, or configuration.

Although leak prevention supports liquid containment, the source adds a plumbing-specific continuous-operation acceptance condition and does not change the existing requirement to isolate electrical components from liquid.
Several minutes of operation is specified to demonstrate leak-free plumbing, not as a new motor durability or maximum-speed duty constraint.
The source does not change power capacity, overload protection, reserve margin, or the required set of simultaneous electrical loads.
The leak-free plumbing criterion does not change mixing quality, foam quality, whisk selection, positioning, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The client's acknowledgement that the machine is sturdy confirms no new structural criterion, while the substantive modification concerns plumbing leakage.
The plumbing repair and leak-free acceptance condition do not change any food-contact material standard.
